name: map_add
statement: C ⥤ D) (hF : W.IsInvertedBy F) [Preadditive D] [F.Additive] : φ.add.map F hF = φ.fst.map F hF + φ.snd.map F hF

name: neg'_eq
statement: L.obj X ⟶ L.obj Y) (φ : W.LeftFraction X Y) (hφ : f = φ.map L (inverts L W)) : neg' W f = φ.neg.map L (inverts L W)

name: add'_eq
statement: L.obj X ⟶ L.obj Y) (φ : W.LeftFraction₂ X Y) (hφ₁ : f₁ = φ.fst.map L (inverts L W)) (hφ₂ : f₂ = φ.snd.map L (inverts L W)) : add' W f₁ f₂ = φ.add.map L (inverts L W)

name: neg'_add'_self
statement: L.obj X ⟶ L.obj Y) : add' W (neg' W f) f = L.map 0

name: add_eq_add
statement: C} (eX' : L.obj X'' ≅ X') (eY' : L.obj Y'' ≅ Y') (f₁ f₂ : X' ⟶ Y') : add W eX eY f₁ f₂ = add W eX' eY' f₁ f₂

have_tree.name: h₁
have_tree.body: comp_add W eX' eX eY (𝟙 _) f₁ f₂

have_tree.name: h₂
have_tree.body: add_comp W eX' eY eY' f₁ f₂ (𝟙 _)

name: functor_additive_iff
statement: Type*} [Category* E] [Preadditive E] [Preadditive D] [L.Additive] (G : D ⥤ E) : G.Additive ↔ (L ⋙ G).Additive
